action.message:
Final review complete. The only change is in src/dotenv/main.py, set_key's quoting branch (lines 184-187): backslashes are escaped before apostrophes via value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'"). This makes the parser's single-quote escape decoding (\\→\, \'→') reproduce the exact original value, so literal backslashes (including consecutive ones) and apostrophes round-trip correctly under quote_mode='always' and 'auto' when read back with dotenv_values(interpolate=False).

Preserved behavior: quote_mode validation and selection, the 'never'/unquoted path, export prefixing, and the rewrite/replace logic are all unchanged. No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were touched. All host acceptance and selected upstream regression tests passed.

Remaining limitations: the fix targets single-quoted output only (the format set_key emits); double-quoted values are not produced by set_key, so their escape handling is unaffected. Values containing newlines are still written literally inside single quotes (multiline), which the parser supports but is outside the reported scope.
